limitations: No independent qualityResult or ontologyResult is produced.
Counts derive from the ten exact named XML reports and selected actual primary logs; older prototype/targeted logs are not aggregated.
The XML files have no suite timestamp attribute; recorded filesystem mtimes and final-log provenance are supplied to expose freshness.
Current source hashes document read-time bytes, not an assertion that uncommitted HEAD itself contains the tested candidate.
Raw XML, system-out, raw application logs, JWTs, request payloads, settings, environment values and credentials are excluded.
Conditional skips and the lint configuration failure remain explicit.
Process exit codes are primary-agent tool receipts when explicitly supplied; omitted receipts are not inferred from log text.
